column2: Creates a Spellstone which can be used to enchant your weapon with Shadow, increasing your spell haste by 1% and the damage done by your Shadow spells by up to 14.\n\nConjured items disappear if logged out for more than 15 minutes.

Creates a holy Lightwell near the priest. Members of your raid or party can click the Lightwell to restore 1,165 health over 10 sec. Being attacked cancels the effect. Lightwell lasts for 3 min or 5 charges.

Creates a holy Lightwell near the priest. Members of your raid or party can click the Lightwell to restore 800 health over 10 sec. Being attacked cancels the effect. Lightwell lasts for 3 min or 5 charges.

Creates a violent storm in the target area causing 132 Nature damage to enemies every 1 sec, and increasing the time between attacks by 20%. Lasts 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.

Creates a violent storm in the target area causing 69 Nature damage to enemies every 1 sec, and increasing the time between attacks of enemies by 20%. Lasts 10 sec. Druid must channel to maintain the spell.
Curse of Agony, renamed. Bane of Doom the same. Banes and Curses are now separate, so you can run one of each.
Curses the target for 5 min, reducing Magic resistances by 30 and increases Magic damage taken by 4%. Only one Curse per Warlock can be active on any one target.
Damage dealt versus Beasts increased by 5%.
Damage dealt versus Elementals increased by 5%.
Deals 12 to 14 Fire damage to a target.
Dismiss your pet. Dismissing your pet will reduce its happiness by 50.
Dispels 1 Curse or Bane from a friendly target.
Dispels magic on the target, removing 1 harmful spell from a friend or 1 beneficial spell from an enemy.
Distract the target, causing threat.
Distract the target, causing threat. More effective than Distracting Shot (Rank 1).
Dodge chance increased by 1% and movement speed increased by 2%. Night Elf Rogues and Druids are harder to detect in Stealth as if they were 1 level higher.
Drains 198 to 210 mana from a target. For each mana drained in this way, the target takes 0.5 Shadow damage.

Drains the soul of the target, causing 170 Shadow damage over 15 sec. Non-trivial targets damaged by Drain Soul have a chance to grant you a Soul Shard. Non-trivial targets killed by Drain Soul will always grant you a Soul shard. Soul Shards are required for other spells.
Duration of Stun effects on you reduced by 20%.
Dwarf Priest

Each rank starts your talent points one level earlier. At 5/5: You gain talent points every level starting at level 5 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points. (Rank 1 starts them at level 9. Read at 5/5 on Soda's BlizzCon stream.)
Earned from challenges, spent across the account. 16 points at launch. Some perks need points in their tree first, a few need the perk before them. The ? slots are placeholders.
Enslave Demon, renamed. Rank 1 by 38.
Entangles an enemy in a corrosive web, immobilizing them and dealing 12 Nature damage over 4 sec.
Entangling Roots in the Druid spellbook
Every Priest gets it. 3 min cooldown.

Every class page has a Popular builds fold under the trees now: the spec split, the five complete builds people shared, saved and opened most (one click loads any of them), the talents almost everyone takes and almost nobody takes, and a switch that paints each talent's pick rate onto the tree. It comes from the site's own visit counts for 12 to 17 Sep, 16,176 different builds, aggregated with no identities involved. Recounted since with the days that were missed, see the newer entry.

Every spell read off footage says Same as Classic, New in Forever, or Changed from Classic with the exact words highlighted, plus the old cost or cooldown line when that moved. 108 spells changed, 71 match, 50 are new. Spells still on Classic text keep saying so until they get read in beta. A Discord reader asked for this one.
Execute-style Shadow spell. Named by the Early Demise talent.
Exposes all hidden and invisible enemies within 10 yards of the targeted area, and staves off magical darkness for 30 sec.
Fade out, discouraging enemies from attacking you for 10 sec. More effective than Fade (rank 1).

Fills the Paladin with divine fury for 30 sec, causing melee attacks to deal an additional 14 Holy damage. While a shield is equipped, each attack also grants an absorb shield equal to 50% of the Holy damage dealt. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.\n\nUnleashing this Seal's energy causes 66 to 72 Holy damage to an enemy and taunts the target to attack you for 4 sec.

Fills the Paladin with divine light for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to heal the Paladin for 39. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.\n\nUnleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, granting melee attacks made against the judged enemy a chance of healing the attacker for 25. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

Fills the Paladin with divine wisdom for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to restore 50 of the Paladin's mana. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.\n\nUnleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, granting attacks and spells used against the judged enemy a chance to restore 33 mana to the attacker. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

Fills the Paladin with holy spirit for 30 sec, granting each melee attack an additional 11 to 40 Holy damage. Slower weapons cause more Holy damage per swing. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.\n\nUnleashing this Seal's energy will cause 96 to 104 Holy damage to an enemy.

Fills the Paladin with holy spirit for 30 sec, granting each melee attack an additional 2 to 8 Holy damage. Slower weapons cause more Holy damage per swing. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.

Fills the Paladin with the spirit of a crusader for 30 sec, granting 107 melee attack power. The Paladin also attacks 40% faster, but deals less damage with each attack. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.\n\nUnleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 40 sec, increasing Holy damage taken by up to 58. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.

Fills the Paladin with the spirit of justice for 30 sec, giving each melee attack a chance to stun for 2 sec. Only one Seal can be active on the Paladin at any one time.\n\nUnleashing this Seal's energy will judge an enemy for 10 sec, preventing them from fleeing. Your melee strikes will refresh the spell's duration. Only one Judgement per Paladin can be active at any one time.
